top_50_categories_summary: Pair Diff (sym_i - sym_j core): 18 features - v6_pairwise alignment, baseline strength
Cross-Sectional Demean (sym - cross_mean): 14 features - market-neutral signals
Cross-Sectional Zscore + Rank: 9 features - Numerai/Alpha101 style
Cross-Impact OFI Pair: 3 features - Cont/Cross-Impact 2023 directly
implementation_notes_for_worker_b: Group features into 5-batch outputs (1 batch per anchor sym i). For pair-diff features: produce 10 pair values per sym (each sym paired with 4 others, total 5*4=20 if directional, or 10 unique pairs). For csec features: produce 1 value per sym (5 vals per group). Concat to existing 259-d feat -> total ~259 + 50*5 = ~509d if all, but only pick top-50 priority for first run. Validate sym-robustness via LOSO (leave-one-sym-out) test before final accept.

high_sym_robustness_concern: F105/F106 cointegration spread with frozen params (high)
skip_if_concerned_about.rationale: These features have high sym_robustness_concern. Avoid in first iteration because v6_pairwise SOTA was achieved with sym-agnostic design. Test in ablation after validation of P1+P2 top 50.

test_protocol_for_worker_b.step_1: Implement top 30 P1 features. Add to v6_pairwise feat (259d -> ~509d).
test_protocol_for_worker_b.step_2: Quick smoke test: 1 seed train of v6_pairwise + new feats. Compare to SOTA +37.25.
test_protocol_for_worker_b.step_3: If smoke test shows +0.3 or better: 5-seed validation. Report new SOTA mean ± std.
test_protocol_for_worker_b.step_4: If smoke regresses or breaks: investigate sym-robustness. LOSO test (leave-one-sym-out) any feature that contributes.
test_protocol_for_worker_b.step_5: Iterate: add P2 batch if P1 shows lift. Otherwise stop and report.

common_pitfalls_to_avoid: Sym-specific normalization (e.g. per-sym z-score) violates sym-agnostic constraint
Frozen cointegration params (F105/F106) require per-pair sym-specific beta — verify safe at test
DTW/MST graph features (F094-099) only 5 nodes — limited info, hard implementation, low gain
Lead-lag features that need time-series state (Predictor stateless constraint)
Avoid stateful features: anything requiring tracking across test batches violates Predictor stateless rule
